indicadores.subtitulo: Pendentes sem pedido gerado; faturados quando já possuem pedido vinculado
sqlBase: SELECT T003_Id AS id, T003_Id AS documento, T003_Data_Emissao AS data, COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T003_Nome_Cliente) AS descricao, COALESCE(D018_UF, 'Não informado') AS uf,
CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T005 WHERE T005_C004_Id = :empresa AND T005_T003_Id = T003_Id) THEN 'Faturados' ELSE 'Pendentes' END AS situacao, T003_Valor_Total AS valor
FROM T003 LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T003_D024_Id LEFT JOIN D018 ON D018_Id = D024_D018_Id
WHERE T003_C004_Id = :empresa AND T003_Data_Emissao BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim AND IFNULL(T003_Flag_Perdido, 'N') <> 'S'
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T003_Nome_Cliente, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

indicadores.subtitulo: Pendentes sem NF-e; faturados quando possuem NF-e vinculada
sqlBase: SELECT T005_Id AS id, T005_Id AS documento, T005_Data_Emissao AS data, COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, '') AS descricao, COALESCE(D018_UF, 'Não informado') AS uf,

CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T007 WHERE T007_C004_Id = :empresa AND T007_T005_Id = T005_Id AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Inutilizado, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Denegado, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 'Faturados' ELSE 'Pendentes' END AS situacao, T005_Valor_Total AS valor
FROM T005 LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T005_D024_Id LEFT JOIN D018 ON D018_Id = D024_D018_Id
WHERE T005_C004_Id = :empresa AND T005_Data_Emissao BETWEEN :dataInicio AND :dataFim AND IFNULL(T005_Flag_Devolucao, 'N') <> 'S'
SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Numero_Nota_Fiscal AS documento, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,
COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao) AS descricao, T007_Valor_Frete AS valor
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

indicadores.subtitulo: NF-e de venda, sem devoluções e importações
sqlBase: SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Numero_Nota_Fiscal AS documento, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,
COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao) AS descricao, D018_UF AS uf, COALESCE(D020_Nome_Cidade, 'Não informado') AS cidade,
CASE WHEN T007_Flag_ACP = '6' THEN 'NF-e' WHEN T007_Flag_ACP = '8' THEN 'NFC-e' ELSE 'Outro' END AS tipoDocumento,

CASE WHEN D018_UF IN ('AC', 'AP', 'AM', 'PA', 'RO', 'RR', 'TO') THEN 'Norte' WHEN D018_UF IN ('AL', 'BA', 'CE', 'MA', 'PB', 'PE', 'PI', 'RN', 'SE') THEN 'Nordeste' WHEN D018_UF IN ('DF', 'GO', 'MT', 'MS') THEN 'Centro-Oeste' WHEN D018_UF IN ('ES', 'MG', 'RJ', 'SP') THEN 'Sudeste' WHEN D018_UF IN ('PR', 'RS', 'SC') THEN 'Sul' ELSE 'Não informado' END AS regiao,
INNER JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id
LEFT JOIN D018 ON D018_Id = D024_D018_Id
LEFT JOIN D020 ON D020_Id = D024_D020_Id
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

sqlBase: SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Numero_Nota_Fiscal AS documento, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,

INNER JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id
LEFT JOIN D018 ON D018_Id = D024_D018_Id
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

indicadores.subtitulo: Clientes ativos sem compra há mais de seis meses, incluindo quem nunca comprou
sqlBase: SELECT D024_Id AS id, D024_Nome_Empresa AS descricao,
MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) AS data,
CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE DATEDIFF(:dataFim, MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END)) END AS diasSemComprar,
CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) IS NULL THEN 'Nunca comprou' ELSE 'Sem compra há mais de 6 meses' END AS situacao, 1 AS valor

LEFT JOIN T007 ON T007_D024_Id = D024_Id AND T007_C004_Id = :empresa AND T007_Data_Emissao <= :dataFim AND T007_Flag_Entrada_Saida = 'S' AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Emitida_Recebida, '') <> 'R' AND IFNULL(T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe, '') <> '' AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Inutilizado, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(T007_Flag_Denegado, 'N') <> 'S'
LEFT JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id AND IFNULL(D006_Flag_Devolucao, 'N') <> 'S' AND D006_Flag_Venda_Compra_Outros = 'V'
AND (D024_Data_Ativo IS NULL OR D024_Data_Ativo = '0000-00-00' OR D024_Data_Ativo <= :dataFim)
AND (:cliente = '' OR D024_Nome_Empresa LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%') OR D024_Nome_Fantasia LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))
HAVING (MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) IS NULL OR MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) < DATE_SUB(:dataFim, INTERVAL 6 MONTH))
AND (MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) IS NULL OR MAX(CASE WHEN D006_Id IS NOT NULL THEN T007_Data_Emissao END) >= :dataInicio)

card.descricao: Clientes ativos cuja última compra é anterior a seis meses ou que nunca compraram.

indicadores.subtitulo: Amostras vencidas sem recompra em seis meses
sqlBase: SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Numero_Nota_Fiscal AS documento, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,
COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao) AS descricao, T007_Codigo_CFOP AS cfop,
DATE_ADD(T007_Data_Emissao, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AS prazo, 'Sem recompra - reenviar amostra' AS situacao, 1 AS valor
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id

AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T007 AS T007Compra INNER JOIN D006 AS D006Compra ON D006Compra.D006_Id = T007Compra.T007_D006_Id WHERE T007Compra.T007_C004_Id = :empresa AND T007Compra.T007_D024_Id = T007.T007_D024_Id AND T007Compra.T007_Data_Emissao > T007.T007_Data_Emissao AND T007Compra.T007_Data_Emissao <= DATE_ADD(T007.T007_Data_Emissao, INTERVAL 6 MONTH) AND T007Compra.T007_Flag_Entrada_Saida = 'S' AND IFNULL(T007Compra.T007_Numero_Protocolo_Nfe, '') <> '' AND IFNULL(T007Compra.T007_Flag_Cancelada, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(T007Compra.T007_Flag_Inutilizado, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(T007Compra.T007_Flag_Denegado, 'N') <> 'S' AND IFNULL(D006Compra.D006_Flag_Devolucao, 'N') <> 'S' AND D006Compra.D006_Flag_Venda_Compra_Outros = 'V' AND T007Compra.T007_Codigo_CFOP NOT IN ('5911', '6911'))
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(D024_Nome_Empresa, T007_Cliente_Razao, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

card.descricao: Clientes cujo prazo terminou sem nova compra.
